entries.say: Do I need a police report to file a claim?
entries.reply:
According to the Claims FAQ, you only need a police report for theft claims. If your Insured Gnome was stolen, you must file a police report and include the report number when you submit your claim.

Vandalism and accidental breakage claims (Plus and Premier tiers) don't require a police report. Photo documentation is enough for those claim types.

The Coverage Guide agrees: theft is the only claim type that requires a police report, and damage and vandalism claims do not.

entries.say: Who reviews weather damage claims?
entries.reply:
According to the Coverage Guide, weather and water damage claims are individually reviewed by a GnomeGuard adjuster rather than being processed automatically, even at the Premier tier (the only tier that covers this type of damage).

The Claims FAQ adds that claims involving weather or water damage always go through adjuster review regardless of tier, which can extend turnaround beyond the standard processing windows.
